# Every pre target finishes before any default target starts, and every
# default target before any post target, without declared dependencies.
bit
grep '\Asetup\n(main|other)\n(main|other)\nreport\n\z' order.log

-- BUILD.bit --
pre setup = exec {
  command = "sleep 0.3; echo setup >> order.log"
  inputs = []
}

post report = exec {
  command = "echo report >> order.log"
  inputs = []
}

main = exec {
  command = "echo main >> order.log"
  inputs = []
}

other = exec {
  command = "sleep 0.3; echo other >> order.log"
  inputs = []
}
